title: Which plugin skills start only from their command?
context: Turning off automatic start (disable-model-invocation) takes a skill's description out of the listing paid on every turn, but then it starts only when the Developer types its command, not from a plain ask. discover runs its step skills (get-connected, understand-idea, ground-in-project, shape-idea, decide-together, write-tickets, check-tickets, post-tickets) by name, so turning automatic start off for them would break discover unless discover loads their files instead. dashboard, join, onboard and start are reached by command or plain ask today.
